claim_label: approximate reproduction; frozen V3/447 failure diagnostic

scientific_decisions.decision: Reuse frozen native128 contours, retained and top10-rejected boxes, pinned PARSeq readings and exact matching helpers; preserve all 2204 care words.
Additive nested matching: exact retained -> geometric retained -> geometric including top10 rejects. The last increment is a localization opportunity, NOT measured extra correct OCR.
BBox coverage/area/fragment diagnostics are proxies, not pixel-mask topology or causal failure attribution; reuse coverage .5 / fragment fraction .05 from NATIVE128-FAIL-001.
Per-contour best-of-six-padding oracle is GT-dependent diagnostic only; keep base pad1 contours fixed, with at most one match per contour.
Causal gains from GT/loss/resolution/crop changes and exact pixel topology cannot be established by this frozen bbox/OCR analysis. All tuning requires TRAIN validation.
